guidebook.intro: Mu Lungereza ebigambo ebinyonyola tebikyuka. Mu Lusoga ogamba ekikopo ekimyufu, omuntu omuwanvu, abantu abawanvu. Mu Lungereza ekigambo kye kimu buli kiseera: a red cup, a tall man, tall men.

tips.title: Langi zidha mu maaso
body: Mu Lusoga langi edha oluvanyuma lw’ekintu: **ekikopo ekimyufu**. Mu Lungereza edha mu maaso: **the red cup**, **a black book**, **a white bed**.
Okubuuza langi, gamba **What colour is it?** oba **Which colour?**

tips.title: “The cup is red”
body: Okugamba ti ekintu kiri bwe kityo, kozesa **is** ku kintu kimu ne **are** ku bingi: **The cup is red.** **The cups are red.**
Ekigambo ekinyonyola tekyongerwako **-s**: **big cups**, si “bigs cups”.

tips.title: Abantu n’ebintu
body: Mu Lusoga **omukade** ne **ekikade** bya njawulo. Mu Lungereza byombi biba **old**: **an old man**, **an old bed**. Ne **young** kozesa ku bantu, **new** ku bintu: **a young child**, **a new book**.
**Tall** ne **short** bikozesebwa ku bantu: **The man is tall. I am short.**

culture.title: “Old” mu Lungereza
body: Mu Lusoga okuyita omuntu **omukade** kiba kitiibwa. Mu Lungereza okugamba omuntu ti **old** kiyinza okumunyiiza. Kozesa **older** oba **elderly**: **an elderly woman**.
